title: Praktik inom systemintegration, AI och automatisering
description:
Vill du utveckla smarta tekniska lösningar som gör verklig skillnad i en verksamhet inom finans?
Kapita Investment Group söker en driven och nyfiken praktikant som vill arbeta med systemintegration, AI och automatisering. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla lösningar som går från idé och kod till driftsättning och faktisk användning i verksamheten. Vi söker dig som gillar att lösa problem, tänka nytt och omsätta tekniska idéer till praktiska resultat.
Om Kapita Investment Group
Kapita Investment Group är ett progressivt investeringsbolag inom finans, med fokus på investeringar, affärsutveckling och långsiktigt värdeskapande. Vi verkar i en dynamisk och föränderlig bransch där analys, innovation och effektiva processer är centrala delar av verksamheten.
Vårt kontor ligger centralt på Avenyn i Göteborg, där du blir en del av ett dynamiskt team med ett gemensamt engagemang för verksamhetens utveckling. Vi värdesätter initiativförmåga, nyfikenhet och ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt. Hos oss uppmuntras nya idéer och egna initiativ, och vi tror på att kombinera affärsmässig förståelse med teknisk innovation.
Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och bidra till vår fortsatta utveckling och utforska hur teknik och AI kan skapa smartare, mer effektiva och skalbara lösningar inom finans.
Om praktiken
Som praktikant hos Kapita Investment Group kommer du att arbeta med att koppla samman våra befintliga system och automatisera arbetsmoment som i dag hanteras manuellt. Du får arbeta med verkliga utmaningar och utveckla lösningar som implementeras och används i verksamheten.
Du blir delaktig i hela utvecklingsprocessen, från att identifiera behov och utveckla kod till att testa, driftsätta och dokumentera färdiga lösningar. AI används där det tillför konkret värde, exempelvis för att analysera data eller som en integrerad del av ett automatiserat arbetsflöde.


Dina arbetsuppgifter
Utveckla API-integrationer mellan våra befintliga system.
Identifiera, utveckla och automatisera manuella arbetsflöden.
Integrera AI och språkmodeller i automatiserade processer där det skapar konkret nytta.
Utveckla, testa och driftsätta lösningar i Azure.
Felsöka, optimera och vidareutveckla integrationer och automatiserade flöden.
Dokumentera tekniska lösningar, implementationer och utvecklingsprocesser.
Bidra med egna idéer kring hur teknik kan effektivisera och förbättra våra interna processer.



Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som studerar inom datateknik, Data Science och AI, mjukvaruutveckling, teknisk fysik, automation eller ett närliggande tekniskt område. Du har kommit en bit in i din utbildning och vill utvecklas genom att arbeta med verkliga tekniska utmaningar.
Du är analytisk, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad. Du tycker om att förstå hur system fungerar, hitta smartare sätt att lösa problem och omsätta idéer till fungerande lösningar. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, men vi ser gärna att du har byggt egna projekt och vill fortsätta utvecklas genom praktiskt arbete.
Vi söker dig som har
Pågående studier inom IT, datateknik, mjukvaruutveckling, automation eller ett närliggande område.
Praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga något som använder ett API, som du kan visa upp eller beskriva.
Programmeringskunskaper i Python eller TypeScript.
Grundläggande kunskaper i Git och vana att arbeta i terminalen.
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt, eftersom svenska är arbetsspråket på kontoret.
Professionella kunskaper i engelska, eftersom teknisk dokumentation och många utvecklingsverktyg är på engelska.



Vad erbjuder vi?
Du kommer att arbeta nära din handledare och få möjlighet att ta ansvar för konkreta uppgifter, utveckla din tekniska kompetens och bidra med egna perspektiv. Vårt dynamiska team och vår ambition att kontinuerligt förbättra verksamheten ger dig möjlighet att se hur tekniska initiativ kan omsättas till praktiska resultat.
Praktisk information
Praktikperiod: 3–6 månader.
Ersättning: Praktiken är obetald.
Arbetsplats: På vårt kontor på Avenyn i centrala Göteborg.
Arbetssätt: Praktiken genomförs på plats. Distansarbete erbjuds inte.
Antal platser: En.
Startdatum: Enligt överenskommelse.
Sista ansökningsdag: 15 november 2026.



Vi välkomnar i första hand ansökningar från studenter vid Chalmers, exempelvis inom Data Science and AI, Software Engineering and Technology, Datateknik, Systems Control and Mechatronics samt Automation och mekatronik. Även studenter från Göteborgs universitet och yrkeshögskolor är välkomna att söka, särskilt om praktiken kan genomföras inom ramen för en LIA-period.
Ansökan
Låter det här som rätt möjlighet för dig? Vi ser fram emot att höra mer om dig och dina tekniska projekt.
Din ansökan ska innehålla:
CV.
Personligt brev där du berättar om dig själv, ditt tekniska intresse och varför du vill göra praktik hos Kapita Investment Group.
Länk till din GitHub-profil eller en egen projektsida.



Vi lägger stor vikt vid praktisk erfarenhet, eget driv och förmågan att omsätta kunskap till fungerande lösningar. Praktiken är obetald.

title: ServiceNow-utvecklare
description:

Unibase är ett växande IT-företag med passion för att skapa värde för våra kunder genom smarta tekniska lösningar. Vi arbetar med spännande projekt och samarbetar med kunniga kollegor. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad genom att utveckla och förvalta lösningar i ServiceNow-plattformen.

Vi söker en erfaren ServiceNow-utvecklare till Unibase!
Som ServiceNow-utvecklare kommer du bland annat att:
Utveckla, konfigurera och anpassa lösningar i ServiceNow-plattformen

Skapa och anpassa workflows, business rules, UI policies och script

Utveckla rapporter och dashboards för uppföljning och analys

Underhålla befintliga lösningar och säkerställa hög tillgänglighet

Integrationer mot andra ITSM-verktyg eller affärssystem

Din bakgrund
Vi söker dig som har:
Minst 5 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom ServiceNow-utveckling
God förståelse för ITSM-processer och ServiceNow-arkitektur
Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande erfarenhet
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt

Varför ska du bli en del av vår familj?
Vårt engagemang för mångfald och inkludering
Vi värdesätter mångfald och strävar efter att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö. Alla kvalificerade sökande uppmuntras att ansöka, oavsett kön, ålder, etnicitet, religion, funktionsvariation eller sexuell läggning. Vi tror att olika perspektiv berikar vårt team och vår verksamhet.

title: System Manager | Early Career Program
description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   About this opportunity   Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI  contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. This isn’t a programme where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. Your journey within the Innovate Program will start as System Manager at Business Area Core Network in Gothenburg. 
     What you will do   This is an opportunity to build a strong foundation in 5G Core, 6G evolution and end-to-end systems while developing towards future technical leadership.You will work at the intersection of technology, innovation and business. You will explore emerging technologies, take part in system-level studies, contribute to technical direction and learn how ideas become standards, products and customer value.•    Participate in system studies on 5GC/6G evolution, new capabilities and emerging use cases.•    Analyse technology trends, research, customer needs and business priorities, and help turn them into requirements, architecture options and recommendations.•    Contribute to 3GPP-related reviews, technical discussions and standardization activities, especially in areas relevant to Packet Core and end-to-end network evolution.•    Explore end-to-end scenarios such as mobility, interworking, enterprise and IoT, network slicing, edge, roaming, QoS and resilience.•    Assess impacts on interfaces, performance, operations, security, lifecycle, migration and customer value.•    Work with architects, product management, development, research, standardization and customer-facing teams across Ericsson.•    Help connect standardization and innovation to product realization, verification, deployment and customer impact.•    Participate in root-cause analyses and learn from complex technical cases.•    Use AI-assisted methods responsibly for technology exploration, standards analysis, requirements and technical material—always validating results and protecting confidential information.•    Bring your own ideas to innovation workshops and contribute to idea incubation.Your development journey will be shaped together with you. The goal is to help you grow into roles such as Technology Specialist, innovation leader, technical coordinator, program lead or another future technical-leadership position.
  
 You will bring 
 •    A Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics or a related technical discipline.•    Strong technical competence, analytical skills and the ability to learn quickly.•    Curiosity about telecom, cloud-native systems, AI, networking and the evolution towards 6G.•    An innovative, entrepreneurial and creative mindset, with the energy to explore ideas and turn them into practical outcomes.•    A collaborative and communicative approach—you enjoy working with people from different technical and business backgrounds.•    An interest in connecting technology to customer value, portfolio decisions and business impact.•    Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.
 In addition, you have: Experience with 5G Core, Packet Core, 3GPP, Kubernetes, CNFs, cloud platforms, CI/CD, performance, service assurance or 6G studies is valuable, but not required. What matters most is your potential, motivation and willingness to take on complex challenges.

title: Senior C++ developer Packet Core

title: Join Our Team as a SW Engineer
description:
About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Automotive Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for the full software development lifecycle of embedded systems for automotive applications, from requirement analysis through to qualification testing. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and work independently to deliver high-quality software components.
Key Responsibilities
·      Analyze software and hardware requirements for automotive embedded systems.
·      Design system architecture, detailed modules, and software interfaces.
·      Develop, test, and integrate embedded software, including hardware drivers and bootloaders.
·      Conduct unit testing, integration testing, and qualification testing in compliance with automotive standards.
·      Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support system bring-up and debugging.
·      Document design specifications and test procedures.
·      Work efficiently both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
What You'll Bring
·      3+ years of experience in automotive embedded systems development.
·      Proficient in C/C++ programming; scripting experience in Python, Shell, or Perl.
·      Strong understanding of microcontrollers, device drivers, and embedded systems.
·      Hands-on experience with bootloaders, cross compilers, and toolchains.
·      Familiarity with software development lifecycle and working with hardware manuals, schematics, and data sheets.
·      Practical experience with automotive communication protocols: SPI, CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet.
·      Experience with debugging tools, simulators, emulators, and test equipment.
·      Team player with excellent self-management and communication skills.
Nice to Have
·      Experience with AUTOSAR Classic Platform development.
·      Familiarity with AUTOSAR Configuration Tools (e.g., DaVinci, ECU Spectrum).
·      Understanding of Functional Safety concepts (ISO 26262).
·      Experience with multi-threaded and multitasking systems.
·      Knowledge of Automotive SPICE or CMMI frameworks.
Benefits & Perks:
·      Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
·      Health, dental, and vision insurance.
·      Flexible work hours and remote work options.
·      Learning and development opportunities
.      Work with a talented and passionate team in a collaborative environment.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer to Markem-Imaje
employer: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
description:
About Us
Markem-Imaje is a trusted world manufacturer of product identification and traceability solutions, offering a full range of reliable and innovative inkjet, thermal transfer, laser, print and label application systems. Markem-Imaje delivers fully integrated solutions that enable product quality and safety, regulatory and retailer compliance, better product recalls and improved manufacturing processes.
Markem-Imaje Sweden in Gothenburg is something as unusual as a small innovation and development hub with a startup mindset within an established global company.
Our mission is to lead the development of new innovative products and solutions, from concept to production with the freedom to use the work methods we find most efficient. We love what we do, and we have help from the global organization we are a part of.
The Role
As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer at Markem-Imaje, you get to work at the heart of our Print & Apply platform, as part of a small team in an international context where ideas move quickly from discussion to implementation and everyone's technical input matters.
In this role, you will:

Be directly involved in and influence important technical decisions for the development of our Print & Apply products.


Work close to the hardware you are building software for, developing a system level understanding of how your code interacts with the motors, sensors, and electronics around it.


Collaborate with the wider team, both locally and across the global organization, drawing on their experience while helping shape the direction of the products you work on.

What You Will Do
The role involves hands on coding, mainly in C++ in a Linux environment, developing the controller software that runs our Print & Apply products. You will work close to the hardware, from motors and sensors to the electronics that drive them, testing and troubleshooting your own code together with the team.
Beyond the core C++ development, you will have the possibility to:

Develop interfaces in Golang.


Develop motor control in C on FreeRTOS.


Collaborate closely with the electronics and mechanics teams to test and troubleshoot hardware related issues.


Take part in code reviews and contribute to improving the quality of the codebase together with the team.

What You Need To Have
Bachelor's degree with significant professional experience developing software; a Master's degree is highly desired but not essential.


Senior experience in embedded development, mainly in C++.


Experience with low level programming, sensors, and motor control.


Comfortable making technical decisions and driving development forward in collaboration with a small team in an international context.


Basic understanding of physics, for example through relevant university education.


Experience with Go programming and previous work with Linux ARM processors would be advantageous.
If you believe you match our values and have the experience we're looking for, then apply as we review applications on a rolling basis! We can't wait to hear from you!

title: Senior Developer to Relay Software Team
description:
About Us
Mullvad VPN is a Swedish VPN company dedicated to fighting mass surveillance and censorship. We do this primarily through our VPN service and our privacy-focused web browser. Over the years, we have been pioneers when it comes to VPN technology and we intend to remain trailblazers. Everything we do is built with our users’ security and privacy first — with the ambition of making mass surveillance and censorship impractical.
The Job
We're looking for a Senior Developer to join our Relay Software Team at Mullvad. This team is responsible for all custom software solutions used on our VPN relays.
You'll play a key role in advancing server support for technologies such as Quantum-secure tunnels, traffic-analysis protection and protocol obfuscation.
Who Are You
You're someone who enjoys working in a team, contributes ideas proactively, and has a strong interest in security, networks and low-level software development.
You value quality, maintainability, and thoughtful software design. You are curious and eager to learn, and you understand the importance of digital privacy.
Responsibilities
Work on new and exciting technologies and greenfield projects.


Using Go, design and implement robust server software for running on Linux.


Author clean solutions that balance performance and resource usage.


Perform measurements, testing and troubleshooting.


Coordinate with stakeholders and developers in other departments.

Qualifications
Excellent written and spoken English and Swedish.


Highly developed understanding of software design and all aspects of software implementation.


Experience with building server software.


Excellent understanding of networking fundamentals.


Strong knowledge in at least one of C/Go/Rust.

Why Mullvad?
We value quality over quantity and believe in good solutions rather than quick fixes. Our apps are open source, our teams are curious and collaborative, and we care deeply about removing bloat rather than adding it.
We are a bunch of diversified peeps: from vegans to marathon runners, audiophiles to farmers and coffee brewers. So, what unites us? Our commitment to living and breathing our mission, to make mass surveillance and censorship impractical. 
If you want to build products that make an impact, enjoy generous benefits, and work for a purpose you can stand behind, welcome to Mullvad.
Additional Information
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden Start: As soon as possible Job Hours: Full-time, hybrid 60% on-site position
This is an ongoing recruitment process and we aim to fill the position as soon as possible. Please note that due to the holiday season, there may be some delays in our response times. We appriciate your patience and will get back to you as soon as possible. 
As part of our hiring process, we conduct a background check to ensure a safe and secure work environment.

title: System Developer
description:
The world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
Your role
We are looking for a System Developer to join our Automotive team in Gothenburg.
In this role you will play a key role in:
•  Developing a system fulfilling the agreed cross-functional solution.
•  Making sure that our solutions comply with all agreed requirements.
•  Breaking down and distribute functional requirements to the execution environment, functional and non-functional realization in Car Weaver (System Weaver) in cooperation with the team and relevant stakeholders.
Your profile
•  University degree in Electronics, Software, Mechatronics or equivalent
•  Minimum 2 years of experience from System Engineering or having gained good electrical system knowledge working with SW testing
•  Previous experience from system development would give you additional advantage to excel in this position
•  Fluency in English
•  Driving license "B" or ambition to take it in the near future
Meritorious skills:
It's beneficial and would bring additional impact and contribution to our team if you have experiences in Simulation and Model-Based Design using MATLAB/ Simulink, System Weaver, Elektra, Vehicle communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Flexray, Ethernet). Knowledge of automotive standards Functional Safety ISO26262 and Cyber security ISO21434.
What we believe you will enjoy about working here 
•  We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance. 
•  At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities. 
•  We support your personal development and offer an education library with more than 250 000 (!) courses and educations and certifications.
About Capgemini 
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. title: Customer & Product Specialist
description:
Customer & Product Specialist — bli en av våra första i Sverige

Nu ska den bli ännu enklare, smartare och bättre — och nå fler. Därför söker vi två personer som ska jobba nära både våra kunder och vår produkt.
Du kommer in tidigt och jobbar tätt med grundaren och utvecklingsteamet, och får en ovanligt bred inblick i hur ett modernt SaaS-bolag faktiskt drivs — från kundproblem och produktbeslut till AI, testning och förbättringar. Bakom Artigan står en grundare som byggt SaaS-bolag tidigare.
Det här kan mycket väl vara ditt första riktiga jobb. Vi bryr oss betydligt mer om hur snabbt du förstår saker, hur du löser problem och vad du faktiskt får gjort än om vilken utbildning eller titel du haft tidigare.
Rollen Du är länken mellan kunden, produkten och utvecklingsteamet. Ena stunden hjälper du en kund som har fastnat i systemet. Nästa stund testar du en ny funktion, försöker förstå varför något inte fungerar som tänkt, spelar in en kort instruktionsvideo eller beskriver en förbättring som utvecklarna ska bygga. Hos oss är "jag har skickat det vidare" inte samma sak som att något är klart — du följer problemet hela vägen tills kunden eller produkten faktiskt har en fungerande lösning.
 Du kommer bland annat att:

använda AI som ett naturligt arbetsverktyg: research, problemlösning, dokumentation, testning, analys och prototyper


ha löpande kontakt med kunder och ge snabb, personlig support


reagera direkt när en kund behöver hjälp — även om du inte har lösningen ännu


förstå vad kunden säger, men också vad kunden egentligen behöver


felsöka tillsammans med utvecklingsteamet och driva frågan hela vägen till lösning


testa nya funktioner, försöka slå sönder dem och avgöra om de verkligen är klara


se när något fungerar tekniskt men ändå är onödigt krångligt för användaren


beskriva förbättringar på ett sätt som utvecklarna kan agera på


skapa dokumentation, hjälpmaterial och korta support- och produktvideor


hjälpa nya kunder att komma igång 


Vem du är Du ser ett problem och börjar ta reda på hur det går att lösa, utan att vänta på en detaljerad instruktion. Du spelar hellre in en snabb Loom än skriver ett långt mejl och du blir irriterad när en bugg får ligga kvar utan att någon gör något åt den.
Du lär dig snabbt och är tekniskt orädd. Du behöver inte vara utvecklare, men ett API, en integration eller ett okänt system ska väcka nyfikenhet snarare än få dig att tänka "det där får någon teknisk person ta" — och du kan förklara en teknisk sak för en kund utan att blinka. Du gillar kunder och får energi av att hjälpa människor; hör någon av sig är din instinkt att svara snabbt och börja lösa, inte att lägga ärendet i en kö. Du har produktkänsla — ser när ett flöde är krångligt eller ologiskt, även när det fungerar tekniskt. Och du trivs med flera saker igång samtidigt: en supportfråga, ett kundmöte, ett funktionstest och en uppföljning under samma dag — och tycker det är roligare än jobbigt.
AI är redan en självklar del av hur du arbetar. För oss betyder AI-native mer än att använda ChatGPT för att formulera texter — du använder AI för att faktiskt få saker gjorda: förstå problem, researcha, testa idéer, automatisera, prototypa och förbättra i korta feedbackloopar. Du har sannolikt redan byggt eller automatiserat något med verktyg som Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Lovable eller Google AI Studio, bara för att du tyckte att det borde gå att göra smartare.
 Så jobbar vi Artigan är ett litet bolag med korta beslutsvägar och högt tempo. Vi bygger, testar, lär oss och förbättrar hela tiden, och AI är en naturlig del av hur vi får mer gjort. Vi löser hellre ett kundproblem idag än diskuterar i tre möten om vem som ansvarar för det. Det här passar inte dig som behöver en färdig rollbeskrivning och tydliga överlämningar — det passar dig som gillar ansvar, tempo och friheten att själv lista ut hur något bäst blir löst.
 Praktiskt

Placering: vårt kontor centralt i Göteborg, med viss möjlighet att jobba hemifrån.


Anställning: tillsvidare, med tjänstepension, försäkringar, friskvård och en egen budget för din utveckling. Vi tillämpar provanställning (6 månader).


Lön: sätts utifrån din erfarenhet och vad du tillför.


Språk: du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska. Engelska används dagligen i samarbetet med utvecklingsteamet.


 Så söker du Skicka ett enkelt CV och  en kort video, någon minut lång, där du presenterar dig och vad som lockar. Beskriv gärna något du gjort med AI nyligen, verktyg du använda och hur du arbetade dig fram. 

 
Om Artigan Artigan är ett svenskt AI-first-bolag som bygger moderna SaaS-, app- och webblösningar för resebranschen. Vår plattform hjälper researrangörer att automatisera sådant som annars kräver mycket manuellt arbete, ge sina kunder bättre service och arbeta smartare. Vi är ett litet team, gillar korta beslutsvägar, och tror att kombinationen av bra produktförståelse, nära kundkontakt och modern AI kan förändra hur en hel bransch arbetar.

title: Platform Engineer - Customer Zero
description:
Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!
At Coretura we build one software platform for commercial vehicles, and we deliver it as a single product to multiple customers including Volvo and Daimler. It is never finished: every change we make reaches both manufacturers, often several times a week. That kind of tempo is only possible if you can prove a release is solid before it leaves the building. That is why we built Customer Zero.
What is Customer Zero?
Customer Zero is the Coretura canary OEM: a real, production-shaped tenant run as if it were an external customer, with its own identities, its own network, and its own access boundary, outside the internal Coretura network. It is the first real recipient of every release, and the point is simple: find what is broken or rough before Volvo, Daimler, or the next OEM does.
What you will be doing
You own the technical environment that makes Customer Zero credible, not just that it exists, but that it genuinely behaves like the environment of a real customer, by making sure the build environment and development tools work in an OEM context. 
In practice, that means building and maintaining the infrastructure, keeping the developer portal and development environment operational. Setting up routine validation on every release to make sure that every release is better than the last. You will team up with our Customer Zero Lead and work closely with Quality Release Engineers and own the technical cloud domain of the simulated customer environment. 
Communication is at the heart of the role. Customer Zero sits between teams, so you will spend much of your time sharing what you find, explaining why it matters, and aligning developers and stakeholders around it. You communicate in a way that builds trust and brings people together.
What you will be working with:
AWS infrastructure provisioning as code with Terraform and Virtual Engineering Workbench


Our developer portal, built in Next.js and Bun


Docker, GitHub actions, Gerrit, other CI systems


Artifactory, ECS, Grafana


Playwright, Python or other test frameworks

We believe you bring
Previous experience developing embedded software


Solid experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform on AWS


Hands-on experience running container-based workloads with Docker and ECS/Fargate


Confidence in GitHub, building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or CI tools.


Experience from functional safety or cyber security development, such as ISO- 21434, ISO-26262 or ISO 27001, is a plus rather than a requirement.

Why this role?
The fun part is that nothing written above is set in stone. It will change, it must change, as we learn more and the demands on us grow. You are part of that ride. 
Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?
We review applications on a continuous basis—so don’t wait to submit yours!
Last application date: 3rd of November 2026.
Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position.

title: Senior Embedded Software Platform & Integration Engineer
description:
Company description:
"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."
Job description:Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
 Join us as an Senior Embedded Software Platform & Integration Engineer, where your expertise and skills will be the driving force behind securing our vehicle systems and protecting connected vehicles from evolving cyber threats.
  
 Are you ready to be part of a groundbreaking transformation?
 At Function & Software Defined Vehicles (FSDV), we shape tomorrow’s technology by delivering sustainable, innovative, and data-driven solutions that improve safety, efficiency, and performance throughout the vehicle life cycle. We support the Volvo Group engineering community with advanced platforms, tools, methods, and architectures that enable continuous innovation and deliver customer value throughout a vehicle's lifetime.
  
 This is us, your new colleagues
 We are responsible for our embedded software platform which includes Volvo Autosar Platform (VAP) based on Classic Autosar, Linux, and Volvo Dynamic Software Platform (VDSP) based on Adaptative Autosar and Hypervisor technologies. It is on this platform that all in-house developed applications run on and make our commercial vehicles come to life that bring joy to our end-customer and their day-to-day work. Our organization consists of warm, supporting and beyond everything, highly skilled people that seek a new colleague that has worked with embedded software on platform level in an automotive context.
  
 What you will do
  Configure and integrate the AUTOSAR stack, including various Basic Software (BSW) modules and Microcontroller Abstraction Layers (MCALs), to ensure seamless operation within our systems.
 Manage the configuration of software components and watchdogs to align with project specifications and requirements.
 Oversee memory allocation, memory partitioning, and multi-core processing to optimize system performance and efficiency.
 Contribute to software design, collaborating with team members to develop innovative and effective solutions.
 Integrate application and signal databases (CAN/CAN-FD) to enhance data management and communication across systems.
 Perform technical reviews on software component design, code, and testing strategies, including integration test planning.
 Perform fault tracing and troubleshoot errors within the technical area to maintain system integrity and reliability.
  
 
 Who are you?
 You are a collaborative and dependable colleague who enjoys working in cross-functional settings and building strong relationships with stakeholders. You take full ownership of your work, manage your time effectively, and stay focused when complex problems need to be investigated and driven to resolution. You communicate clearly and constructively, and you are comfortable standing by your technical recommendations while staying open to feedback and different perspectives. You bring a structured, quality-minded way of working and a calm approach when priorities shift. You enjoy sharing knowledge, and you are willing to mentor others to help the team grow and deliver a stable embedded software platform over time. 
  
 Requirements: 
  A bachelor's degree or master's degree in computer science, Electronics or Mechatronics Engineering
 10+ years of experience working with Embedded Software
 Proficient in programming languages such as Python and C, with solid experience in software development.
 At least 6 years of experience working with AUTOSAR on platform level, demonstrating a strong understanding of its architecture and components.
 Familiarity with software testing methodologies and tools, including CANoe, to ensure high-quality software delivery.
 Self-driven, with a strong eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.
 Familiarity with automotive communication protocols, network management concepts, bootloaders and functional safety development with ISO 26262 automotive standards.
 Security design using Hardware Security Modules (HSM) for bootloader implementation, to ensure secure booting and secure flashing processes are in place.
  
 
 Ready for the next move?
 We value the uniqueness of every individual and the diverse backgrounds and experiences they bring and ignite curiosity.
  
 If you’re looking to increase your expertise and broaden your responsibility, this is a fantastic opportunity within Volvo Group.
  
 Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to apply.
  
 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.
  
 Last application date: October 18th, 2026.
  
 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
 Who we are and what we believe in
 We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
 Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.

title: Embedded Software Developer - General Lighting
description:
LumenRadio is a high-tech company with the vision of replacing all cables in the world. We have been leading the wireless transformation within the lighting industry since 2008, where our technology is being used every day in the largest TV and Movie productions in Hollywood, at the Coachella festival, and the Eurovision Song Contest. Our patented technologies deliver unprecedented reliability for the most business-critical applications, and our products are now also used in permanent indoor and outdoor lighting installations, as well as in building automation systems.
Replacing cables in lighting control systems with wireless communication makes installations easier, more flexible and more cost-efficient. With rising demands for energy efficiency, wireless lighting control has become a key enabler, making intelligent control possible even where traditional cabling is not.
In our General Lighting team, we work with W-DALI and AirGlow to bring reliable wireless lighting control to real-world environments, using existing DALI systems and without the need for cabling. You will be part of our R&D organization, where we continuously develop and refine wireless communication technology, and are currently focused on building the next-generation platform that enables even higher performance in our wireless solutions.
Your future
We are looking for our next Embedded Software Developer to join our product development team within General Lighting. In this role, you will play an important role in new development projects as well as maintenance assignments on system level, e.g. drawing up requirement specifications, pre-studies, proposals, system design, system testing (QA) and acceptance testing. You will also plan and execute product/project plans and drive process improvements.
An important part of our approach to product development is having a deep understanding of our customers' challenges and closely understanding the environment in which our products are used. As a developer in the team, we expect you to be driven by a desire to understand the industry and participate in technical customer dialogues and support cases when needed. You will balance a deep technical interest and knowledge with the willingness to learn about domain specific requirements, standards, certifications etc.
As part of maintaining a close dialogue with our customers and partners, we expect you to participate in trade shows and engineering meet-ups around the world approximately 2-3 times per year.
About you

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent


Experience in delivering high-quality embedded C firmware


Experience with Python, e.g. for testing purposes


Experience in CI/CD and measuring electronics


A genuine passion for technology, demonstrated by curiosity and a desire to stay informed about industry trends


Fluency in English, written and spoken


While it's beneficial to have prior knowledge of, it's not essential as you'll have the opportunity to learn about:

networking (IPv6, OSI model etc.)


wireless networking (Bluetooth/BLE, Zigbee, WiFi, LoRa, Thread, 6LoWPAN, NB-IoT, 5G etc.)


different lighting- & industry protocols, such as DALI, KNX, BACnet, Modbus, etc.


Our tech stack

Whatever OS and editor that make you productive


Arm-gcc, Git, GNU Make


Robot Framework, GitLab and GitLab CI


Bluetooth, SPI, UART, our own meshing network stack Mira


We are looking for people who share our values – Reliability, Innovation, Simplicity and Energy.
Diversity and culture
We are on a mission to replace all cables in the world, and we are looking for you who share our passion for cutting-edge technology! We value diversity and welcome different-minded professionals who are committed to our ambitious goals. We warmly welcome and encourage job applications from people of all backgrounds and genders.
If you need any adjustments to support you with your application, just let us know by emailing nelly.bertilsson@lumenradio.com.
Our Benefits

We offer good job security through agreements and insurance, paid parental leave, holiday leave, and attractive pension plans📃


Yearly health allowance - For your physical activity and well-being🧘🏽


Yearly personal development allowance - For your brain and creativity🧠


Free access to the gym in the same building🏋🏽‍♂️

Not to mention our Coffee Club, Multipath Running Club, Crafts Club, and much more!☕

In this position, you will report to Erik Abrahamsson, Engineering Manager, Lighting Control, and responsible recruiter is Nelly Bertilsson. Don't hesitate to reach out to nelly.bertilsson@lumenradio.com if you have any questions.

title: Senior Data Engineer till Knowit i Göteborg
description:
Forma framtidens datadrivna lösningar i molnet. Är du en erfaren Data Engineer som vill arbeta nära tekniken och bygga robusta dataplattformar i moderna molnmiljöer? Hos Knowit i Göteborg får du möjlighet att ta ett tekniskt ledarskap i uppdrag där kvalitet, skalbarhet och affärsvärde står i centrum – tillsammans med några av Sveriges mest datatunga myndigheter och företag.
Om rollen som Senior Data Engineer på Knowit
Som Senior Data Engineer hos oss i Göteborg arbetar du med att designa och utveckla avancerade datalösningar i molnet. Du kommer arbeta med moderna principer inom datamodellering, semantic layers och data governance för att skapa robusta och framtidssäkra dataplattformar. Du tar ansvar för arkitekturval, implementation och optimering av pipelines, och fungerar som en teknisk förebild i teamet. Våra uppdrag spänner över både offentlig och privat sektor, där du är med och skapar lösningar där data blir en strategisk tillgång och en central del av verksamheten.
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:
Designa och implementera skalbara dataplattformar i moln (Azure, AWS, GCP)


Bygga och optimera datapipelines med Python och DBT


Säkerställa hög datakvalitet, prestanda och robusthet i komplexa system


Driva tekniska beslut och bidra till best practices inom data engineering


Stötta team och kunder i arkitektur- och designfrågor

Vår teknikstack / verktyg och metoder
Python, SQL


Dagster, Airflow


DBT, Docker, Kubernetes


Snowflake, DataBricks, BigQuery


Molnplattformar: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud


CI/CD och Infrastructure as Code


Vi uppmuntrar ständig teknisk utveckling och du får vara med och påverka både teknikval och arbetssätt i våra kunduppdrag.
Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig med minst 7 års erfarenhet som Data Engineer, som är redo att ta ett större ansvar i team och leveranser. Du har gedigen erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar, Python och DBT, och är van vid att arbeta nära både teknik och affär.
Du är trygg i att leda tekniska diskussioner, fatta beslut och stötta andra. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och trivs i en kultur där samarbete och lärande står i fokus. Erfarenhet av AI och datadrivna organisationer är ett plus.
Vad erbjuder Knowit i Göteborg?
Hos oss får du arbeta i uppdrag som gör verklig skillnad – från samhällsviktiga initiativ inom offentlig sektor till innovativa lösningar i industrin. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med välkända organisationer och myndigheter i en miljö där teknik, lärande och balans står i fokus. Vi erbjuder flexibilitet, ett centralt kontor i Göteborg och en kultur präglad av kunskapsdelning kultur, innovation, hållbarhet och en sund balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Vi har ett modern kontor i centrala Göteborg där vi ofta har aktiviter så som AW, föreläsningar och hackathons.
Är du redo att ta nästa steg som Senior Data Engineer?
Välkommen med din ansökan och bli en del av Knowit i Göteborg!

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Enterprise Architects bridge business strategy and technology, shaping internal initiatives and client engagements in Goteborg through onsite collaboration. You define target architectures and transformation roadmaps, guiding delivery teams and stakeholders to balance business value, cost, risk and maintainability. The role spans technical selling, client-facing projects and alignment to specific accounts based on business priority. You independently lead architecture for business domains or transformation initiatives, working with leaders, product teams, solution architects and specialists to ensure decisions align with enterprise direction. This position matters because it drives sustainable technology choices that support organizational growth.
Responsibilities
Translate business goals into capability assessments, architecture requirements and prioritized transformation roadmaps
Assess the current business, application, data and technology landscape; define target and transition architectures that address dependencies and legacy constraints
Identify opportunities to simplify application portfolios, reduce duplication and technical debt, and reuse enterprise capabilities
Guide architecture decisions across initiatives, maintaining principles, reference patterns, decision records and clear governance for exceptions
Work with delivery teams from discovery through implementation, reviewing designs and resolving cross-system dependencies and architectural risks
Address security, privacy, resilience and regulatory requirements with relevant specialists, balancing delivery needs with enterprise standards
Facilitate stakeholder workshops and architecture reviews, communicate trade-offs clearly and mentor solution architects and technical leads
Support client discovery and technical proposals with feasible solution options, vendor assessments, estimates, risks and business cases, including total cost of ownership
Assess where AI can support business capabilities and advise on data readiness, integration, security and governance in collaboration with AI specialists

Requirements
Ten years of relevant IT experience, including three years in enterprise, domain or solution architecture within complex organizations
Experience leading architecture for at least one transformation initiative spanning multiple systems or business functions, from assessment and target design through implementation
Practical experience in business capability and process mapping, application portfolio assessment and development of target architectures and transition roadmaps
Strong understanding of integration patterns, APIs, data architecture, cloud and hybrid environments, and non-functional requirements such as security, scalability, and resilience
Ability to apply enterprise architecture frameworks and modeling tools pragmatically, producing clear diagrams, standards and decision records that teams use in delivery
Business and financial judgment to compare technology options, assess vendors, and explain cost, benefit, risk and return-on-investment trade-offs
Strong communication and facilitation skills in English, including client workshops and discussions with senior business stakeholders; ability to build agreement across teams without formal authority
Working understanding of privacy, regulatory and industry requirements, with experience translating them into architecture decisions alongside relevant specialists
Working understanding of enterprise AI and generative AI use cases, limitations and key architecture considerations, including data privacy, human oversight and integration with existing systems

Nice to have
Experience in federated enterprises or regulated industries
Exposure to evaluating or integrating AI-enabled enterprise products or supporting an AI adoption initiative
Relevant architecture or cloud certifications, such as TOGAF or ArchiMate; equivalent applied experience is equally valuable
A degree in technology or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience

title: Lead Architect - Digital
description:
We’re redefining how automotive software is built. As a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, Coretura blends startup speed with industry strength.
Ever looked at a system and wondered who on earth decided this? Here’s your chance to be the who.
Coretura Digital is our development kit, internal developer platform, enterprise IT, AI platform, and data and observability. Plenty of good ideas, and they all need to point in the same direction. As Lead Architect, reporting to our CDO, you’re the one who makes that happen.
What you’ll do
You’ll own the target architecture for all of Digital, which mostly means deciding things. A few examples of what will land on your desk:

The Digital target architecture and principles. Yours to write, and yours to keep current


Engineering standards for all of Digital, worked out together with our architects and tech leads


The calls on what’s standard, what’s configurable and what’s off-limits as more customers come on board


Security and regulation built in from the start with our Security Hub, rather than bolted on the week before an audit


How AI shows up across everything we build, together with our AI Hub


You’ll represent Digital in our Architecture Forum, where the big decisions are made, and take the day-to-day calls within Digital yourself. Together with our Head of System Architecture, you’ll also shape how our cloud and the software in the vehicle work together. No automotive background needed, we’ll get you up to speed.
What you bring
You’ve made big architecture calls before, and some of them turned out wrong. You know which ones, and why. That’s exactly the experience we’re after. You probably around a decade of experience in software, a lot of it as the architect who actually decided, ideally somewhere that grew fast. You go deep in cloud, data, AI or enterprise IT, and distributed systems, multi-tenancy and APIs that other developers depend on are familiar territory.
We’re looking for someone who leads through technical credibility and can bring architects and engineers from different teams together around a shared direction. You’re just as credible with executives as with senior engineers, and you know how to guide people toward the solution that works best for everyone.
Why Coretura?
At Coretura, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact. We value initiative, ownership, and a proactive mindset. You’ll have the freedom to drive projects forward, contribute ideas, and help shape the future of commercial vehicle technology. Our lean, innovative team is always learning and adapting, so your contributions will truly matter. 
Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?
We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours!

title: Manager, Delivery Management
description:
Kognic is on a mission to make everything that moves autonomous. Our Delivery Managers sit at the sharp end of that promise: the people who make sure it actually happens for the world’s most demanding automotive and AI customers. We're now looking for our next Kognic leader, ready to own that commitment end to end, leading and developing our team of Delivery Managers who keep our delivery at that same high bar.
The Role
Kognic is scaling fast, and the way we lead our deliveries has to scale with it. This is what you will be part of building. You lead our team of Delivery Managers, around 12 people who own the day-to-day across all our accounts. You shape the team and how it works: how the function meets customers and internal stakeholders. You define what good looks like, then hire and coach in that direction. You balance pragmatism in the day to day with the long-term changes that make us stronger over time.
What You'll Do 
The team works with complex enterprise customers and short turnaround times, which calls for decentralised decision-making and a high degree of autonomy. When delivery is at risk, you own the escalation and its resolution. The path will differ every time, but it always goes through your team, never around them. So the core of the job is to hire and develop the team Kognic needs to execute well. You hire and onboard, and you run performance and salary reviews. You build a team that customers and the rest of Kognic trust with the big moments.
Our customer promise is “the most data for your budget”. As a leader of a critical function in our deliveries, you will have a real impact on our ability to fulfill that promise. You keep a close eye on the budget and margin, both per account and for the company as a whole. You act early to improve outcomes in the short and long term. Succeed here and you have a material impact on how AD and ADAS get developed across the industry.
You report to the VP Operations and join the Operations leadership team, together with leaders of our two other Operations functions, Customer Success and Data Specialists. We set direction together. How your function gets there is yours to lead.
The job will change as the function matures. We are flexible, and you should be too. The role is based in Gothenburg with a hybrid setup possible.
Who you are
You’re a leader who draws energy from building. When customer escalations, commercial pressure, and your own team's growth all compete for your attention, you stay grounded and decisive.

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, Industrial Engineering and Management, Business Administration/Finance, or similar educational background and/or work experience.


Experience:

You have led a team through major change


You have 3+ years of formal leadership and management responsibilities


You have experience of delivery to enterprise customers, with a real grip on margin and P&L. Commercial accountability isn’t new territory for you.



Language skills: Fluent in English, written and spoken.


Leadership Style: You lead through your team. You empower your team with mandate, the tools and coaching to handle situations themselves. You know what is happening in your team and what’s needed next. You create clarity when things are ambiguous, and you thrive in leading through change.


Personality: Curious, can-do energy. You don’t wait to be told what to do. You’d rather try something and adjust than wait for the perfect plan. Confident and without ego.


Nice to have: Experience leading project or delivery managers, working with BPO or supplier relationships, or operating across borders and cultures.

Why Kognic?
We are in it to win, and have a lot of fun while doing it! We aim to win the most demanding customers in the world: global enterprises with little tolerance for error, in a technology that changes every quarter. That kind of work is complex and interdependent, and no team at Kognic can do it alone. So the people are the point. You will work with around 100 talented and humble colleagues of many nationalities who are kind, honest, and ambitious.

You grow faster than you thought possible. With an unusual level of transparency during a time of rapid growth, you will both see and contribute to the scale-up journey.


You are at the forefront of technology in the exciting field of AI, playing a major role in automotive as a whole.


You get the practical things too: team and office events, parental pay, salary exchange, great health benefits, insurance, place your own pension - to name a few.


From our early days as a pure start-up to our current life as a scale-up, we work in a dynamic environment, which means that every day might be different from the next, but that is exactly how we want it. Kognicians all have a strong desire to explore uncharted territory and a willingness to constantly be learning.
Join Us!
We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible, as we continuously select and conduct interviews. We do not require a cover letter, but ask you to share your resume and answer a couple of questions in the application.
You are more than welcome to visit our career website to learn more about our recruiting process. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact our Hiring Manager, Olof Fyr at olof.fyr@kognic.com.
About Kognic
Kognic was conceived in the curious minds of Daniel Langkilde and Oscar Petersson, two engineering students, who dared to dream big and help machines make sense of our messy, chaotic, and unstructured world. Kognic’s pioneering dataset management solution helps companies accelerate the development of high-performing and trusted AI products, focusing on bringing the most advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous driving (AD) to market.

title: Automation lead
description:
About Taigatech
We solve some of the most important problems in industry with AI and computer vision. With our connection to the latest research and academia, we take world-leading research in AI and computer vision and turn it into impactful solutions that help the wood industry increase yield, availability, and productivity.
Technology is reshaping our world. We believe the forest and wood products have an important role to play in a sustainable future, and AI is how the industry gets there.
We are a growing team in a comfortable office in central Gothenburg, working closely with many of the leading names in wood processing. Our systems run in production at sawmills and pulp mills in Sweden and abroad. There's no better time to join our journey than now.
Why this role exists
Our systems create value the moment their output reaches the customer's control system — a correction, a signal, something the line can act on.
What determines the results are a handful of decisions made early and made well: which signal, where it lands, what the line does with it, and how it behaves when something unexpected happens. Get those right and the implementation is small and quick.
Today that judgement is distributed between our own team and the automation partners we work with on each installation. We want someone to decide what the interface should look like, judge whether it came out right, decide when a sensor or other component needs replacing, and if the signal belongs on a different fieldbus.
That's the person we're hiring. You don't replace our automation partners. You become the one who leads them.
What you'll do
The role is both technical and leadership, and the balance shifts from project to project.
Own the machine-side interface. You decide how our system talks to the customer's PLC. Signals, timing, handshakes, watchdog, fail-safe behaviour. You write the functional description the work is built from.
Lead our automation partners. Sometimes that means writing the code snippet yourself. Sometimes it means explaining what needs doing and reviewing that it came out right. You decide which.
Make the technical decisions on the customer's plant. Upgrading a component for better results, or moving to a different fieldbus, is yours to propose and drive. The implementation itself normally goes to a partner.
Be the customer's main contact through the project — scope, timeline, status, time and cost reporting. You take over from sales and carry the delivery home.
Clear the path. OT network access, change control, and the dialogue with the site's automation and IT departments, so the installation can be done quickly and safely.
Work closely with our ML and vision engineers. Translate what the process needs into what the model has to output, and the model's limits back into what we can promise.
Make it repeatable. A reusable interface specification, a commissioning checklist, and a growing network of automation partners to deliver alongside.
Who you are
You need experience, but we don't care how many years you have behind you. We care about what you've done.
You have programmed PLCs in live production, on at least one major platform — Siemens TIA/S7, Beckhoff, ABB, Mitsubishi, Codesys or equivalent
You have hands-on experience of industrial networks: Profinet, Profibus, EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, OPC UA or equivalent.
You have extended control systems you did not write with retrofits onto existing, running equipment
You have written functional descriptions that someone else built from
You have stood on site during commissioning, with production running and someone waiting
Drives the project forward by keeping people accountable, asking the right questions, and pushing decisions when it matters — even when that means a difficult conversation.
Swedish and English, and you sometimes travel to sites
Bonus
Sawmill, pulp and paper, or other heavy process industry
Vision systems, sensors or measurement equipment
Experience on the supplier side, responsible for subcontractors
Machinery directive and risk assessment on modified lines
Python and basic data analysis
What we offer
You'll be our first dedicated automation hire. You set the delivery process, and it becomes the standard we scale on. As delivery volume grows, the function gets built around you.
You'll work directly with the founders, with our ML engineers and with the mills themselves. Office in Gothenburg.
We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: Go-to-Market Engineer
description:

As Bjorn Lunden continues to grow across Sweden, Denmark and the Netherlands, we are looking for a Go-to-Market Engineer to join our Commercial Development team.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into actionable insights

We strive for a healthy work-life balance and support this through competitive conditions and benefits and flexible work opportunities. We want to be the natural first choice for people who want to thrive and have fun at work.
